job.title: Recover at Work Administrator
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking a Recover At Work Administrator to join our growing team! In this role you will be responsible for injured employees, their managers, host clients, and other stakeholders to ensure a supportive return to work program.

Full Job Description

  • Support the Safety & Recover at Work teams by providing back-end administrative support
  • Support return-to-work coordination by liaising with insurers, host clients, and internal stakeholders to facilitate claims progression and recovery outcomes
  • Lodge workers’ compensation claims across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant documentation requirements

  • Collate and maintain common law and claims data, demonstrating a high level of attention to detail and confidentiality
  • Provide support to Advisors through reporting, documentation, and follow-ups to ensure recovery actions are progressed effectively
